proposed.sourceName: Heliyon — Towards halal pharmaceutical: Exploring alternatives to animal-based ingredients (Herdiana et al.)
proposed.paraphrase: Peer-reviewed review noting microbial/recombinant gelatin can be a halal alternative but that the use of non-halal growth media for microbial cultivation raises concerns regarding permissibility, so halal status is conditional and requires verifying the media and host are halal-compliant.

proposed.sourceName: Trends in Food Science & Technology — Principles of halal-compliant fermentations: Microbial alternatives for the halal food industry (Karahalil)
proposed.paraphrase: Peer-reviewed review presenting guidelines for halal-compliant fermentation, holding that microbial substitutes are halal only when the production process — growth media, host strain, processing aids and any genetic modification — is itself halal-compliant; otherwise compliance must be verified case by case.

researcherNote: Microbial gelatin regraded to 2 (conditional, verify certification). Under the strict zabiha position the conditionality still applies (substrate/process must be verified halal). Two independent peer-reviewed sources. APPROVED by owner 2026-06-28.
